text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English states that the Federal Council resolved to \"develop the use of nuclear energy\" because hydropower was \"already largely exhausted\"; Italian states the Council expressed itself in favor of a \"direct transition\" from hydropower (already \"almost entirely exploited\") to nuclear energy.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "the Federal Council resolved to develop the use of nuclear energy in order to meet the rapidly growing demand for electricity.", "before": "In the early 1960s, in view of the fact that the existing hydropower capacities were already largely exhausted,"}, "tgt": {"quote": "il Consiglio federale si è espresso a favore del passaggio diretto dall’energia idroelettrica, già quasi interamente sfruttata, all’energia nucleare.", "before": "Per coprire il fabbisogno di elettricità in forte crescita, negli anni Sessanta"}, "severity": 0.6}]}
